10276|2024fca2.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|2024fca2.text: The life of a smith is not an easy one, but it puts steel in yer bones and fire in yer heart. My da' was a smith, my grandfather before him in the forges beneath Grim Batol. And now my son follows in our footsteps, that boy makes me proud.

10277|a7662787.name: Groum Stonebeard
10277|a7662787.text: Eh? I don't have time ta chat, my da' wants me ta finish this order fer him.

11065|9c1c73ea.name: Thonys Pillarstone
11065|9c1c73ea.text: There are ways to strengthen steel beyond the hammer and forge, young wanderer. Care to learn more?

11065|ad07ed45.name: Thonys Pillarstone
11065|ad07ed45.text: Ye're a fine enchanter indeed! Now it's time fer ye to move on. I want ye to talk to Gimble Thistlefuzz, upstairs. He's a bit of a character, but he'll steer ye in the right direction from here on out!

11068|327fd53e.name: Betty Quin
11068|327fd53e.text: I'm afraid I have nothing to teach to someone with your experience. But you haven't reached the end of the road yet. Speak to Lucan Cordell, behind the counter there. He'll guide you through the next phase of your journey.

11072|15d6b2ff.name: Kitta Firewind
11072|15d6b2ff.text: Your skills are truly becoming extraordinary. Now, let us continue your training...

11145|2e8b4855.name: Myolor Sunderfury
11145|2e8b4855.text: Greetings, $N. I am Myolor Sunderfury, keeper of the Great Forge.

1241|4a926ca6.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|4a926ca6.text: Good day to ye lad. Can I be of service?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

12939|e59a68b0.name: Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen
12939|e59a68b0.text: Greetings, $N. I am Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen, head trauma surgeon of Alliance Trauma.

12997|6ce695f2.name: Monty
12997|6ce695f2.text: Monty be me name an' rats be me game.

1317|f472d1d3.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|f472d1d3.text: A true professional know his limitations, and I'm not ashamed to admit that your skills exceed mine. I want you to pay a visit to Kitta Firewind at the Tower of Azora. She is well-renowned, and with good reason.

1318|23d8b931.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1344|d97361a1.name: Prospector Ironband
1344|d97361a1.text: Although we're trudging through a slow period at these ruins, I'm confident it won't last long.  But in the meantime, I could use someone like you.  Would you like to aid the Dwarven Explorers' Guild?

14722|00e95851.name: Clavicus Knavingham
14722|00e95851.text:
Friend - Stormwind needs your assistance and your generosity!

Our once large stockpile of textiles has run critically low.  Stormwind is now engaged in a multi-pronged effort to rebuild those stocks for the manufacture of textiles and bandages!  Your donation of cloth would help Stormwind immensely, as well as earn the respect of the citizenry!

15127|e2791228.name: Samuel Hawke
15127|e2791228.text: I am Samuel Hawke, the main supplier for the League of Arathor posted here at Arathi Basin.  As you improve your standing with us, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you might find useful.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1700|c2467ddc.name: Paxton Ganter
1700|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

1702|263b99e7.name: Bronk Guzzlegear
1702|263b99e7.text: Just a minor adjustment here... ah there we go!

1976|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

1976|4fc5af49.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|4fc5af49.text: Ah, you're looking for Lucan Cordell.  He runs a shop on the outside of the Magic Quarter on your way to the Stockade.

1976|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

2277|985afd1f.name: Loremaster Dibbs
2277|985afd1f.text: Hello, $N! What can I do for you?

2352|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Anderson
2352|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

246848|59873409.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|59873409.text: What is your curiosity looking for?

246848|aa74f3e4.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|aa74f3e4.text: Is there something I can help you with?

247264|a8fa316f.name: Emissary Jacques
247264|a8fa316f.text:
Hail and well met, traveler.

I wish my arrival was met with good tidings but the realm of Dalaran is in need of aid from the kingdoms of the Alliance.

2485|1c7cd7a4.name: Larimaine Purdue
2485|1c7cd7a4.text: I do not believe you possess the mental acuity to grasp the nature of portal magic.

2543|41cbc7e1.name: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver
2543|41cbc7e1.text: Take care while in our city, $c. We are ever wary of strangers since the city was destroyed, and any untoward behavior while within this place will not be tolerated.

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256729|06bc17cb.name: Nina Surefire
256729|06bc17cb.text:
I know what you're thinking, but don't worry, we keep our cooking and alchemy ingredients separate!

How can I help you?

256732|9285f4a0.name: Alynsia
256732|9285f4a0.text: You look like you could use a few enchants. You have come to the right place!

256735|8db10840.name: Mivin Shadowweave
256735|8db10840.text: <Mivin gestures toward his wares and back at you again with a smile, but says nothing.>

257446|1e35c538.name: Teo Hammerstorm
257446|1e35c538.text:
The stone an' soil speak truer than any tongue, if ye quiet the clatter in yer heart long enough to hear 'em. 

If ye've the makings of a $c, I'll teach ye.

258098|1605f087.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

259023|77b9d9d7.name: Veyric Thunderhame
259023|77b9d9d7.text: The stones here are carved by ancient hands, shaped by ageless winds.

267309|17fe3dc6.name: Bainham
267309|17fe3dc6.text: I don't have time for idle chatter, $c.

269127|1e33d6fe.name: Image of Archmage Modera
269127|1e33d6fe.text:
If you've tried to enter Dalaran, you've likely met with the Kirin Tor guards. They are under strict orders not to let outsiders into the city while this disruption runs rampant. The council has decreed that keeping up appearances is more important than preventing a catastrophe.

I suffer no such delusions.

275243|a3886d45.name: Teller Gee
275243|a3886d45.text: Apologies, sir. The bank isn't open yet. Please come back later, if you don't mind.

276235|6ef477da.name: Archmage Modera
276235|6ef477da.text:
Ah, $N. It's good to see you. After all your help, you're a welcome guest in our halls.

Please, make yourself at home. Dalaran owes you at least that much.

2832|78a6229e.name: Nixxrax Fillamug
2832|78a6229e.text: First drink's on me! The coin to pay for it, that is. On my hand. From you.

2835|c5ceacbe.name: Cedrik Prose
2835|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

28989|0a03e13c.name: Aemara
28989|0a03e13c.text:
I'm hoping to open my very own shop soon! In the meantime, would you like to buy anything?

Every bit counts towards funding my dream!

29660|0b9b101a.name: Sai
29660|0b9b101a.text: $N, ready to join the big battle at Alterac Valley?

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3442|c0ad1190.name: Sputtervalve
3442|c0ad1190.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

3845|10ec66f1.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
3845|10ec66f1.text: We elves have a long history.  Let us hope this history does not return to haunt us.

4256|d1bed30c.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
4256|d1bed30c.text: If you ask me, there's no greater profession than a miner.  And if you ask me, there's no greater miner than a $r!

4258|bb5f9372.name: Bengus Deepforge
4258|bb5f9372.text: I hope ye didn't come all the way to the Great Forge just to stay warm. Speak up lad, tell me what it is I can do for ye?

4319|c5ceacbe.name: Thyssiana
4319|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4321|c5ceacbe.name: Baldruc
4321|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4430|1eae49d1.name: Gnome Pit Crewman
4430|1eae49d1.text: I installed a new device in our car's matrix regulometer.  That should increase its velocity quotient by a factor of no less than fifteen!

4452|a84fd61d.name: Kravel Koalbeard
4452|a84fd61d.text:
Come a little closer.  We have important matters to discuss, you and I.

And some of them we don't want everyone to hear...

4453|f1c43d2c.name: Wizzle Brassbolts
4453|f1c43d2c.text: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, mister. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.

5111|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
5111|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

5157|2d217d8f.name: Gimble Thistlefuzz
5157|2d217d8f.text: What do I look like, the Grand Poobah of enchanters? Your skills require the guidance of an Artisan! Go find Kitta Firewind at the Tower of Azora.

5157|7805515d.name: Gimble Thistlefuzz
5157|7805515d.text: Great, let's get started... ha! Fooled you! Surely you didn't think it would be that simple. You'll need to prove your mettle just like everyone else!

5164|fe2e6e4c.name: Grumnus Steelshaper
5164|fe2e6e4c.text: What can I do for ye?

5497|544e5c2b.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|544e5c2b.text: Well met, $c.  My advice to you is this: as you travel the world, be wary of magic for it will burn the untrained.

5502|fb513610.name: Shylamiir
5502|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

5595|632a21ad.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|632a21ad.text: Well well!  You've come to the right place to learn Mining, boyo!  Geofram Bouldertoe himself resides at the Deepmountain Mining Guild.  Ye couldn't ask for a better instructor than him.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|b26bebdf.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|b26bebdf.text:
Och!  Ye should be careful what ye get enchanted lad.  I had me mug enchanted so it wouldn't spill a drop, but now I can't drink from it!  Such a tragedy.  

You be sure to heed me advice when ye see Gimble.  He'll be in his shop right by the Gryphon Master at The Great Forge.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5595|ec597f71.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ec597f71.text: Ah, I believe Gimble Thistlefuzz is who ye'll be needing if yer looking to learn the Enchanter's profession.  Ye'll find Gimble in his shop, Thistlefuzz Arcanery, right by the Gryphon Master at The Great Forge.

5694|f9a7a324.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
5694|f9a7a324.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

6826|f676e73a.name: Talvash del Kissel
6826|f676e73a.text: Um, hello!  If you are here about fee collection and/or a summons, then you must have me mistaken for someone else.  Terribly sorry!

68|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

68|819b99eb.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|819b99eb.text: Lucan Cordell has a small shop on the canal by the Stockade. I am sure he will be able to teach you the art of enchanting.

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

727|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

733|60b8c5ae.name: Sergeant Yohwa
733|60b8c5ae.text: You watch where you step around here, son.  You might not be a part of our outfit, but that doesn't mean I won't take a cane to you if you fall out of line!

738|00545e9d.name: Private Thorsen
738|00545e9d.text: This is a dangerous place, $N. Be careful around here.

773|30546fd3.name: Krazek
773|30546fd3.text: $C, eh? I am Krazek, Baron Revilgaz's secretary. I know everything about the goings on in this jungle and beyond. Perhaps you'd be interested in knowing the going price on oil in Ratchet? No? Looking for work, maybe? I can help you there.

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

9558|18531f4a.name: Grimble
9558|18531f4a.text: You look like you might be needing passage across the Great Sea. Well you have come to the right place, this here is the berth of the Maiden's Fancy, finest passenger ship to travel these waters. When she arrives, just climb aboard and the next thing you know you will find yourself basking on the sandy beaches of Stranglethorn or throwing back a drink in Booty Bay.

1069-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-accept.text:
Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay!  The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.

I smell an opportunity!

In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider.  Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!

In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.

In Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
1069-accept.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1104-accept.name: Fizzle Brassbolts
1104-accept.text:
I have so many designs for our rocket car!  So many!  And I must try them all!!

I'm working on a new type of fuel.  One that burns really really really hot!!  I haven't gotten the mixture perfect, but I think I know what I need...

The scorpids who wander the Shimmering Flats have a venom with lots and lots of salt in it.  It's very unique!  And it's just what I need!

Bring me venom and trust me -- our car will fly!!
1104-accept.title: Salt Flat Venom

1105-accept.name: Wizzle Brassbolts
1105-accept.text:
My brother is working on a new fuel for his rocket car.  He's brilliant, he really is.  So brilliant that... I think that new fuel he's designing is strong enough to eat right through the car's chassis!

I want to reinforce its fuel tanks before that happens.

The tortoises out on the flats have very hard shells.  I want to use them to create new tanks for our rocket car.  Tanks that can hold my brother's new fuel.

You look responsible enough.  $N you get me those shells?
1105-accept.title: Hardened Shells

1110-accept.name: Kravel Koalbeard
1110-accept.text:
Heh heh, with all the races they're running here, it's no surprise that a few mishaps happen along the way.  If you look around the Shimmering Flats then you'll see evidence of past crashes -- scraps of rocket car parts are littered everywhere!

And those parts are worth money to the gnomes and goblins.  They're always looking for more contraptions to slap onto their cars.

So go out and get me parts.  Bring me a heap and I'll pay you well.
1110-accept.title: Rocket Car Parts

1111-accept.name: Kravel Koalbeard
1111-accept.text:
I make it my job to get people what they need, and the gnomes over there need a parts order filled.  Their parts were shipped to Ratchet a week ago, but I haven't been able to make the trip.

So, are you ready for some legwork?  Go to Ratchet and give this parts order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig -- he'll probably be at the docks.

Do this for me, and I'll have more jobs for you.

Jobs, my friend, with serious profit potential...
1111-accept.title: Wharfmaster Dizzywig

1133-complete.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1133-complete.text: You are here to offer your services to the Alliance, $N?  We welcome the aid, for although its beauty remains... Ashenvale Forest is not the peaceful place it once was.
1133-complete.title: Journey to Astranaar

1134-accept.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1134-accept.text:
We are not in open war with the Horde, but our peace is fragile.  We often find their agents moving against us, but they do so covertly.

One such advance was revealed to us from hidden sources in Theramore, claiming that the orcs collect venom from the pridewings near Mirkfallon Lake, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the south.  Orc assassins then use the venom on their secret death raids against the Alliance!

If this is true, then we must stop them, $N.  We must deny them their source of venom.
1134-accept.title: Pridewings of Stonetalon

1142-complete.name: Treshala Fallowbrook
1142-complete.text:
No!

'Tis not fair. Oh, cruel and intolerable world!

I must now carry this burden of grief and not let Heralath's work die with him.

You were brave to journey from such a dangerous place, $N. But please leave me now.

In solitude I shall mourn.
1142-complete.title: Mortality Wanes

1142-progress.name: Treshala Fallowbrook
1142-progress.text: What brings you to my home, $r?
1142-progress.title: Mortality Wanes

1175-accept.name: Trackmaster Zherin
1175-accept.text:
After the big crash with the goblins' Red Thunder racer and a basilisk, Kronkrider hired me on to take care of the track. I don't know what all the animals out on the flats are feeding on to grow so big, but we have to be careful to thin them out so they won't wander onto the track when a race is going on.

Tell you what. If you want to go out and make a little profit, go out and remove the basilisks from the area.
1175-accept.title: A Bump in the Road

1176-accept.name: Pozzik
1176-accept.text:
When it comes to racing, every bit counts! Whether it's a minor tweaking on the power output, a slight slackening on the tension coils, or lightening the weight of the frame, you have to take everything into account.

We use vulture bones for a lot of the minor structural tweaks we make to our racers, which offer the perfect balance of strength and weight. Even better, it's easy for us to get more, as the salt flats are littered with vultures.

Bring me some and I'll give you a good price on them.
1176-accept.title: Load Lightening

1221-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1221-accept.text:
Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.

It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
1221-accept.title: Blueleaf Tubers

1302-accept.name: Vincent Hyal
1302-accept.text:
My brother James went with Lady Proudmoore across the sea. Last I heard, the fighting had settled down over there, and James was setting up an inn somewhere on the continent. Wherever he is, I'm sure he's doing good business. Damn fine cook he was.

I haven't heard from him for a while now--too busy with his inn, I'd wager--but the clerk in Theramore could probably point you to him.
1302-accept.title: James Hyal

1302-complete.name: Clerk Lendry
1302-complete.text:
James Hyal, James Hyal... Why does that name sound so familiar?

Of course! The Shady Rest Inn incident. If you have any information about what happened there, I would urge you to speak with Captain Vimes about it. He's handling the investigation.
1302-complete.title: James Hyal

1483-accept.name: Sputtervalve
1483-accept.text:
The Venture Company stole many of the best goblin minds, but from time to time, we get the opportunity to steal some back.

A while ago, the Venture Company outfit in the Stonetalon Mountains hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle--a gnome! Their other engineer, Ziz Fizziks, was so taken aback by this, he pleaded with me to find him new employment with the Tinkers' Union. I set him on a few tasks, but he might need help.

Maybe you could look in on him for me? He's stationed at the western edge of Windshear Crag.
1483-accept.title: Ziz Fizziks

189-accept.name: Kebok
189-accept.text:
Damn trolls! They've been killing off our agents in the jungle! I've already lost a good number of my best guards to skirmishes with them. The costs are piling up! How will I explain this to Baron Revilgaz?

Decisive action... Think, Kebok... you weren't assigned to the post you have today for sitting around... I've got it! You... $N, is it? You'll help me, won't you? There's money to be had!

Here's the deal... you bring me the ears of fifteen Bloodscalp Trolls, and I'll compensate you well.
189-accept.title: Bloodscalp Ears

198-accept.name: Krazek
198-accept.text:
Hmm. Yes, I do have something you could do, actually. Lieutenant Doren and his followers up in the north need their regular supplies from us.

They haven't been delivered, and with the trolls attacking, I'll need someone to do it. Doren's camp lies northwest of the road at the entrance to Stranglethorn from Duskwood. Give the supplies to Private Thorsen, if he's not in the camp, then he'll be patrolling south of it. He'll take care of them.

Mind you, if you fail, you'll owe me restitution.
198-accept.title: Supplies to Private Thorsen

198-complete.name: Private Thorsen
198-complete.text: These land mines will help us defend ourselves from that animal Kurzen and his men. Thank you for bringing them. If you need further work, I can probably find something for you to do. And you won't have to deal with those goblins, hm?
198-complete.title: Supplies to Private Thorsen

198-progress.name: Private Thorsen
198-progress.text: Yes? What do you want? Oh, supplies from the goblins. Strange seeing a $r delivering them, usually they send their own. No matter... you didn't touch them did you? Good good... we wouldn't want anything to happen to our mines, oh no.
198-progress.title: Supplies to Private Thorsen

200-accept.name: Lieutenant Doren
200-accept.text:
If Kurzen knows Thorsen's secret, then we have a spy in our midst.  We must determine how the secret was leaked!

Thorsen's contact within Kurzen's camp was Bookie Herod.  Herod is Kurzen's logistics officer and knows everything about the running of Kurzen's Compound.  If you can get Herod's notes or records, maybe we can find out how Thorsen was discovered.

When we were still with Kurzen, Bookie's office was on the top floor of the camp's only two-story house.  His records are probably still there.
200-accept.title: Bookie Herod

201-accept.name: Krazek
201-accept.text:
I've gotten reports of a group of hunters that have set up camp upriver of the Venture Company mining camp on Lake Nazferiti. Now, normally I wouldn't care, but improbably, I heard that Hemet Nesingwary was one of the hunters there? He's certainly well-connected, if you catch my meaning, and you never can be too safe.

Why don't you go check out the camp, $N, see what they're about?
201-accept.title: Investigate the Camp

203-accept.name: Sergeant Yohwa
203-accept.text:
We're fighting a losing battle with Colonel Kurzen.  Not only is he a brilliant tactician, he outnumbers us at least 10 to 1!  To survive, we need to use his own, covert tactics against him.

Enter his camp to the east and kill his men.  Lots of them.  And get out before reinforcements can close on you.
203-accept.title: The Second Rebellion

204-accept.name: Sergeant Yohwa
204-accept.text:
To have a chance against Kurzen, we need his healing support neutralized.  He has gathered around him a large number of Medicine Men who heal his forces with Jungle Remedies and poison our fighters with Venom Fern Extracts.

We need those remedies to cure our own people, and we need a sample of those extracts to study so we can make our own remedies.  Search the Kurzen Compound for both - his Medicine Men will have the remedies, and the extracts are probably stowed in some of the camp's supply boxes.
204-accept.title: Bad Medicine

215-accept.name: Private Thorsen
215-accept.text:
Thank you for saving me, $N.  I know how this looks, but...allow me to explain.

I was charged by Lieutenant Doren to re-enlist with Kurzen's men, so that I might spy on them and bring sorely needed intelligence to the rebels.  You saw here what I had thought would be my chance to infiltrate Kurzen's Compound.  I was wrong, and again, thanks for saving me.

This was a top secret mission, so you must tell no one.  But if you speak with Doren he will explain.
215-accept.title: Jungle Secrets

215-complete.name: Lieutenant Doren
215-complete.text:
Yes, what Thorsen told you is true.  You must be discrete with this.  At one time, we rebels were fiercely loyal to Colonel Kurzen.  But such was Kurzen's corruption, our passion twisted into rage.   If it was made known that Private Thorsen has had recent dealings with Kurzen's men, then one night he would find himself with a slit throat.

To my knowledge, only Sergeant Yohwa, Thorsen and I were privy to Thorsen's mission.  But there must be another.  A traitor.
215-complete.title: Jungle Secrets

2945-complete.name: Unknown
2945-complete.text:
You place the ring inside the Sparklematic 5200 and deposit a silver coin into the slot.

Painful grinding noises emanate from the machine as it begins to jerk around violently.  One can only guess what is happening with the ring inside the machine...

The machine suddenly stops, trumpeting its cessation with a simple "Ding!"  The item receptacle opens up to reveal a small box that is neatly wrapped with a red bow.  It would appear that the Sparklematic 5200 also gift wraps!
2945-complete.title: Grime-Encrusted Ring

2945-progress.name: Unknown
2945-progress.text:
The gnomish contraption before you bears a plaque calling it "The Sparklematic 5200".  The gist of the machine, from reading the instructions below the plaque, is to scrub away dirt that an item might have.  The machine has a coin slot, accepting three silver coins to start the process once the item is placed inside it.

It would seem as though the grime-encrusted ring you found earlier is just the thing to try in this machine!
2945-progress.title: Grime-Encrusted Ring

2947-accept.name: Unknown
2947-accept.text:
Opening the box produced by the Sparklematic 5200 reveals what you had suspected - a shiny ring!  Wearing the ring, you feel magic power surge through you body.

Inside the band is a small but nonetheless discernable imprint of the seal of Ironforge.  Next to that, three small initials are engraved: "TdK".  This may signify either the initials of the previous owner, or perhaps the initials of the ring's crafter.  Keep the ring... or return it to this person.  Decisions, decisions...
2947-accept.title: Return of the Ring

2947-complete.name: Talvash del Kissel
2947-complete.text:
A ring, you say?  Let's see... yep, I made that ring by golly.

Before Gnomeregan went up, I had a small shop there.  Perhaps it's one I left behind when I ran for the hills; it's a simple design, and I made several like it.  Maybe it's from someone who didn't make it out.

Dark Iron dwarves had this?  Well, that puts a new layer of conspiracy on the nine different layers already floating about.  Maybe the authorities would like to know; it's wasted on the likes of me.

Now, back to the ring...
2947-complete.title: Return of the Ring

2947-progress.name: Talvash del Kissel
2947-progress.text:
Hey, easy there partner - I'm a very important businessman!  I am sure that the courier is just simply late with the delivery of the rent... wait... you're not my landlord.

Well, of course you aren't - silly me!  You've come to me seeking the finest jeweler in all of Ironforge, one who does NOT make CURSED items!  Yes!

Um... what do you need?
2947-progress.title: Return of the Ring

2948-accept.name: Talvash del Kissel
2948-accept.text:
Listen $N, that ring is yours, sure... but I can make you a better one!  That design, like I said, is really simple.  I am a lot more skilled now, and for the mere fee of thirty silver coins I'll spruce it up for you!  Well, a little more than thirty, actually...

I'm in a tight spot right now; all my material stock is all dried up.  If you bring me a bar of silver and a moss agate, I'll add a silver and agate lattice to the ring that will give it a little more pizzazz!

Trust me!
2948-accept.title: Gnome Improvement

2948-complete.name: Talvash del Kissel
2948-complete.text:
Ah, exactly what I needed!  Someday, when I find myself out of this hole that I am unjustly in, I will make for you, for EVERYONE the finest trinkets in all of Azeroth!  Until then, thanks for being a sport about the reagents.  I'd normally charge ten times what I have charged you for a ring of this quality...

Speaking of rings, here's your new one!
2948-complete.title: Gnome Improvement

2948-progress.name: Talvash del Kissel
2948-progress.text: Do you have the materials I need?  I wouldn't ask you for them if I wasn't down on my luck...
2948-progress.title: Gnome Improvement

2953-complete.name: Unknown
2953-complete.text:
The Sparklematic 5200 comes to life, lurching to and fro.  Inside, the helpless grime that has encrusted the object placed within it is being pulverized by the machine's gnomish cleaning agent.

The Sparklematic 5200 comes to a halt, heralded by a familiar "ding!"  The item receptacle of the machine spirals open, revealing a neatly wrapped box.
2953-complete.title: More Sparklematic Action

2953-progress.name: Unknown
2953-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
2953-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

2962-complete.name: Ozzie Togglevolt
2962-complete.text: <Ozzie examines you.> Impressive, you still have all of your limbs. Now it's time to see what this stuff can do!
2962-complete.title: The Only Cure is More Green Glow

2962-progress.name: Ozzie Togglevolt
2962-progress.text: Hrm, you're not glowing. That's a good sign.
2962-progress.title: The Only Cure is More Green Glow

309-accept.name: Miran
309-accept.text:
Ready to go, $N?

First, we need to get this powder to Ironband. It'll be a lot for me to carry, and these parts can get dangerous -- and who knows what else the Dark Irons might have in store for me.

I'll feel a lot better with you coming along.
309-accept.title: Protecting the Shipment

309-complete.name: Prospector Ironband
309-complete.text:
Oh, thank the Light the powder is here. But it is troubling news that you bring as well. To think that the Dark Irons have sympathizers able to procure this sort of material for their dastardly plans.

That's a matter for someone else to consider, some other time. I must put this powder to good use.
309-complete.title: Protecting the Shipment

500-accept.name: Marshal Redpath
500-accept.text:
Crushridge ogres have dug an ogre mound up in the Alterac Mountains near the ruined city of Alterac.  And my scouts tell me they've taken over those ruins as well.

We can't let them get cozy up there; if they think they're safe where they are, then their next step will be to move down into the foothills, which will put them right at our front door!

Go north to the Alterac Mountains and hunt ogres.  Bring me the Dirty Knucklebones they carry and you will earn a nice bounty.
500-accept.title: Crushridge Bounty

505-accept.name: Magistrate Henry Maleb
505-accept.text:
I am the new magistrate of Southshore, recently assigned after the assassination of the previous magistrate.  The assassins were never found, but through our investigations we're almost certain they were hired by the Syndicate - a group of thieves led by villainous nobles of the now fallen kingdom of Alterac.

The Syndicate has a camp north of the Horde-occupied Tarren Mill, and our last clues led to that camp.  Slay the Syndicate members you find there.
505-accept.title: Syndicate Assassins

536-accept.name: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle
536-accept.text:
Transferred from the Stormwind city guard to Southshore, a town that should be abandoned by the looks of it... Smell of the harbor day and night.

Not to mention ol' Redpath... Wants me to take care of the murlocs. Ha! 

I can barely rouse myself to go out to some of the pockets of the overgrown fish down the Western Strand. If you would go in my place and take care of them, I'd appreciate it.
536-accept.title: Down the Coast

540-accept.name: Loremaster Dibbs
540-accept.text:
Those beastly ogres now reside within Alterac's ruins, and I shudder to think what they're doing with the precious books still there.  You must recover what you can!

Enter the Ruins of Alterac and search for tomes looted by the ogres.  Get whatever you can find and bring them to me, but also seek out one book in particular: The Arm of Gri'lek.  It contains ancient troll lore that I must learn, and the Ruins of Alterac was the last known location of an intact copy of this book.
540-accept.title: Preserving Knowledge

543-accept.name: Count Remington Ridgewell
543-accept.text:
The Perenolde Tiara is an old heirloom of the Perenolde "nobles" - the ruling family of Alterac before that kingdom fell to ruin.  It is said to have been crafted by master jewelers in Ironforge, and fitted with the finest of emeralds.

When Alterac was destroyed the Tiara was lost, but there are rumors that an Ogre Mage, Grel'borg the Miser, found the tiara and now wanders the Ruins of Alterac searching for more treasures.

We would have you acquire the tiara for us.
543-accept.title: The Perenolde Tiara

555-accept.name: Chef Jessen
555-accept.text:
If there's one thing you'll learn about Southshore it's that we have some of the best cuisine north of Stormwind!

Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks to travel from as far as Darkshire just to enjoy a bowl.  Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately.  I used to head up past Dalaran to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt Snapjaws but it's just too dangerous now. If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the Snapjaws up north and Soothing Spices, I'll whip some up!
555-accept.title: Soothing Turtle Bisque

564-accept.name: Darren Malvew
564-accept.text:
Ain't nothin' that irks me more than losin' these here beautiful horses.  And believe me, we've lost quite a few between them pesky undead creeps, the dang Syndicate gang and all the other good-for-nothin' scoundrels pokin' about these parts.

But I swear on my ol' grand-daddy's grave there ain't no bigger menace to our horses here than them Mountain Lions up in Alterac.  Always comin' down from the hills and makin' my life difficult!

You fancy yourself a hero?  Go and do somethin' about it then!
564-accept.title: Costly Menace

565-accept.name: Bartolo Ginsetti
565-accept.text:
I, the great Bartolo, shall make for you the world famous, Alliance renowned, Yeti Fur Cloak!

Travel the planet and find yourself a better cloak, I dare you.  Oh wait, what is that, little $r?  "Bartolo, there is no finer cloak!"  Yes, yes!  That, I have heard before.

Bartolo requires a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak made by a skilled leatherworker, Fine Thread and Yeti Fur, of course!  Bring to me these items and you shall be a happy customer!
565-accept.title: Bartolo's Yeti Fur Cloak

575-accept.name: Drizzlik
575-accept.text:
"The finest leathercrafter of the South Seas and the worlds old and new." That's what they call me. Me! Drizzlik! The finest lea... Ahem. Well.

My leather goods are known far and wide as the most exquisite, a connoisseur's choice!

I've just received an order from Director Riddlevox of the Tinkers' Union for a dozen of his favorite Excelsior-line boots. Our best sellers, actually.

To start on the basic shape, I'll need crocolisk skins from the crocs along the river in northern Stranglethorn.
575-accept.title: Supply and Demand

575-complete.name: Drizzlik
575-complete.text:
These skins should do. Their quality isn't too important, given that they'll make up the inside layer of the boots, but it's still important that they're comfortable.

If they're a bit too rigid, I'll use some tiger blood to soften it up. Tricks o' the trade, you know?
575-complete.title: Supply and Demand

575-progress.name: Drizzlik
575-progress.text:
My equipment is all ready to go, $N, I just need those skins. We don't want to keep Riddlevox waiting, that's for sure.

It's not a good idea for anyone to keep the chief inventor of the Tinkers' Union unsatisfied.
575-progress.title: Supply and Demand

5762-accept.name: Kravel Koalbeard
5762-accept.text:
I have a package for an old customer of mine, a $r named Hemet Nesingwary.  The package took weeks to arrive, and Hemet's long gone by now.  He said he was going to Stranglethorn to hunt the beasts there, but he left me some money to send his delivery when I could.  

Hemet's a rich $r and it's a good idea to keep up relations with the rich ones, yeah?  So... you want to deliver the package for me?

I heard Hemet has a camp in Stranglethorn, north of Grom'gol.
5762-accept.title: Hemet Nesingwary

605-accept.name: Crank Fizzlebub
605-accept.text:
The Singing Crystals are unique to Stranglethorn, and are very valuable to certain parties.  I can move those crystals, but the cursed Venture Company makes it hard for an honest entrepreneur like myself to gather any!

I'd like to hire you.

The basilisks in Stranglethorn eat the crystal.  This gives them their hardened skin, and sometimes decent quality crystal can be harvested from it.

You can get it from any basilisk, but the less nasty ones are along the shores south of Zul'Kunda, to the north.
605-accept.title: Singing Blue Shards

606-accept.name: "Sea Wolf" MacKinley
606-accept.text:
If there's one thing I can't stand, it's people who don't pay their gambling debts!  And there are a lot of people who owe me. Think you can help me collect?

First, there's "Shaky" Phillipe down by the docks.  He owes me plenty after last week's game and I want my due!  But to get it, we'll have to scare him.

Go out of town and hunt Elder Mistvale Gorillas.  Find a nice selection of giblets, then take them to Shaky.  Don't let on that they're from an animal; let him think the worst.
606-accept.title: Scaring Shaky

659-accept.name: Phin Odelic
659-accept.text:
Hail, and well met, $N. I lead a group of adventurers investigating odd happenings in this area.

My cousin in Hillsbrad recently put down his dog Stanley because the animal mystically grew to an immense size and savagely attacked anyone who came near him.

I believe the undead are involved, and we're looking for signs to prove as much.

Two of my companions, Quae and Kinelory, headed to the Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands, and haven't checked in for days. Find them for me? I grow concerned.
659-accept.title: Hints of a New Plague?

690-accept.name: Archmage Malin
690-accept.text:
Greetings, $N. You have the look of an adventurer about you, and I have a task that needs some tending to.

Archmage Trelane, my original master, fled Stromgarde in the Arathi Highlands not too long ago, and he's asked me to help him in recovering some of the items he left behind.

The city fell under siege, and he attempted to defend the Tower of Arathor, but to no avail. I have agents in the Highlands already, but they've requested I send more aid. Are you interested?
690-accept.title: Malin's Request

690-complete.name: Skuerto
690-complete.text: So, Malin sent ye? I don't care if Muradin rose up from the dead and whisked ye here on a dragon. I'm busy! Talk to Kryten if you need somethin'.
690-complete.title: Malin's Request

704-accept.name: Prospector Ironband
704-accept.text:
The last report I received from Agmond is troubling, more so now that he's dead!  He mentioned that his diggers uncovered "ancient urns" at the dig site outside Uldaman.  I fear that the urns he found at that site incited the troggs, just as did the idols I found here.

I need you to get those urns for our studies.  Go to the Uldaman site, gather the urns, then return to me.
704-accept.title: Agmond's Fate

704-progress.name: Prospector Ironband
704-progress.text: Did you find those urns, $N?  We must find the link between them and the troggs!
704-progress.title: Agmond's Fate

739-complete.name: Prospector Ironband
739-complete.text: This is sobering news, $N.  But Agmond had a strong arm and a fierce hammer-swing, and his skull was as thick as they come!  Although he was killed by those cursed troggs I'm sure he took a lot of them down with him.
739-complete.title: Murdaloc

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

78124-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78124-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78124-complete.title: Nar'thalas Almanac

78124-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78124-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78124-progress.title: Nar'thalas Almanac

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

78145-progress.title: Arcanic Systems Manual

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

79092-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79092-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79092-progress.title: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal

79358-complete.name: Veyric Thunderhame
79358-complete.text:
A cleansin' ritual usin' the very twisted totems of our enemies? I knew tae expect great things from ye.

Let's get to work.
79358-complete.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

858-accept.name: Wizzlecrank's Shredder
858-accept.text:
I don't suppose Sputtervalve sent you? I'm in a bind here. I hopped in without realizing that I need a key to unlock the shredder's movement column. One of the other shredder operators asked me if everything was okay, and I panicked! Instead of telling him that I was missing my key, I told him there was some sort of mechanical problem.

We need to get out of here on the double! Go up to the control room at the top of the derrick, the supervisor should have a key for this shredder.

Help me out here!
858-accept.title: Ignition

858-complete.name: Wizzlecrank's Shredder
858-complete.text:
Yep, this looks like the right key. Let me just make sure I know how to work this thing...

Hmm... rotation control... This regulates speed and stability... fine arm movement control. Just look at this! I can't believe the Venture Company could design something this much better than ours. I've got to get this back to Ratchet!
858-complete.title: Ignition

858-progress.name: Wizzlecrank's Shredder
858-progress.text: Quick, we need to get out of here before someone gets suspicious!
858-progress.title: Ignition

863-accept.name: Wizzlecrank's Shredder
863-accept.text: I suppose I'll learn as we go... Couldn't be too hard. Just some buttons here, and a lever or two... Well, are you ready to go?
863-accept.title: The Escape

863-complete.name: Sputtervalve
863-complete.text:
Hopefully we'll be able to get something of value from the wrecked shredder prototype... my time's running out! I'll dispatch a salvage team to Wizzlecrank's location on the double.

Oh, let me give you something for your trouble, too.
863-complete.title: The Escape

865-accept.name: Brom
865-accept.text:
The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands.  And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns!  If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks."  I could sell them for a fortune!!!

And you can help me.  Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws.  They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.
865-accept.title: Raptor Horns

887-accept.name: Gazlowe
887-accept.text:
I sure wish Vice Admiral Grezzlik did a better job of keeping the seas safe for our trading vessels. With all the gold the trade princes have poured into the Trade Fleets, it ticks me off to see so many pirates running willy-nilly, raiding my ships and stealing my goods!

I heard that the Southsea Freebooters have set up a camp just south of here. They've been a real thorn in my side and if Grezzlik won't take care of them, well, maybe you can help me get rid of them.
887-accept.title: Southsea Freebooters

894-accept.name: Sputtervalve
894-accept.text:
The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".

Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.

I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
894-accept.title: Samophlange

894-complete.name: Unknown
894-complete.text: A variety of buttons, levers and blinking lights are somewhat erratically arrayed on the face of the control console. A small gauge indicates that the apparatus is currently operating within optimal levels, and indicates that control valves one through three are currently open. There is a small keyhole set into the lower right side of the control panel.
894-complete.title: Samophlange

895-accept.name: Unknown
895-accept.text:
WANTED!

Baron Longshore, Captain of the Heedless

Captain Longshore of Gilneas leads vessels of the Southsea Freebooters, and is wanted on charges of piracy. Remains must be in identifiable condition!

-- Gazlowe
895-accept.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

895-complete.name: Gazlowe
895-complete.text:
Ahhhh! That sort of business. You know, I saw the Heedless once on the open seas. Fearsome ship, or was that boat... those sailors are so particular!

Anyways, watching her glide across the water was quite a sight to see. I'm glad her infamous captain will trouble my ships no longer.
895-complete.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

896-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-accept.text:
Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.

The latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.
896-accept.title: Miner's Fortune

896-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-complete.text:
Look at the size of that thing, $N! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut--fifty percent, don't worry!

Now let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, $N.
896-complete.title: Miner's Fortune

896-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-progress.text: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
896-progress.title: Miner's Fortune

900-accept.name: Unknown
900-accept.text: The three control valves are currently opened. The various readings on the control panel lead you to presume that they must be shut off before the apparatus can be shut off.
900-accept.title: Samophlange

91723-accept.name: Hamish Bergwort
91723-accept.text:
Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?
91723-accept.title: Delicate Instruments

91753-accept.name: Kitta Firewind
91753-accept.text:
Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.
91753-accept.title: An Enchanting Lesson

91899-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91901-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91901-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91901-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91901-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91901-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91901-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92432-accept.name: Emissary Jacques
92432-accept.text:
I bring ill tidings from Dalaran. Something has disrupted our ley lines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.

We know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!

Archmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near Dalaran beside Lordamere Lake.
92432-accept.title: An Alarming Request

92432-complete.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92432-complete.text:
I see Jacques was successful in garnering aid.

While not strictly permitted, we cannot allow our pride to turn away allies in our desperate hour. Do not let the guards fool you. Things are anything but under control.
92432-complete.title: An Alarming Request

92456-accept.name: Thelade
92456-accept.text:
If you're going to bother me you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.
92456-accept.title: A Green Sample

92456-complete.name: Shylamiir
92456-complete.text:
This is... not what I had in mind.

Clearly the city is going through more than I expected. But what you found is just as fascinating, if not more so.

I guess you're not as troublesome as I thought. Good work.
92456-complete.title: A Green Sample

92456-progress.name: Shylamiir
92456-progress.text: Well? Do you have it yet?
92456-progress.title: A Green Sample

92457-accept.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92457-accept.text:
The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.

While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.
92457-accept.title: Starving Arcane

92457-complete.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92457-complete.text: Thank you $N, this progress will help ensure Dalaran is safe.
92457-complete.title: Starving Arcane

92458-accept.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92458-accept.text:
Whatever disturbed the ley lines, it started at the top of the Violet Citadel. A thunderous crash rang out from the parlors above, and now we are overrun with rampant arcane power. It's taking all we have just to keep the wards in place.

We cannot afford to stall any longer. We need help.

The Kirin Tor are busy inside, but you will still need a less public approach to gain entry. Take this key and meet me in the citadel once you've made your way into the city. We must put an end to this disruption.
92458-accept.title: Heart of Disruption

92458-complete.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92458-complete.text:
I don't know what you saw up there, $N, but it does not matter. What matters now is containing this mote and putting an end to this madness.

You did your part well. Now the rest is up to us.
92458-complete.title: Heart of Disruption

92458-progress.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92458-progress.text: What good is our pride if there isn't a city left standing to be proud of?
92458-progress.title: Heart of Disruption

92459-accept.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92459-accept.text:
The council will not be happy to learn of our subterfuge, but they cannot deny results. The city is calming down, and we are free to lower our wards.

I think it's only fair you deliver the good word. Take this mote to Archmage Celindra within the Violet Citadel.
92459-accept.title: Friend of the Kirin Tor

92459-complete.name: Archmage Celindra
92459-complete.text:
Where did you find this? The parlor?

<Archmage Celindra's expression darkens momentarily before regaining her composure.>

I think it is best you dispel this from your thoughts, friend. For now, the Kirin Tor welcomes a competent $c such as yourself. Welcome to Dalaran.
92459-complete.title: Friend of the Kirin Tor

92459-progress.name: Archmage Celindra
92459-progress.text: Archmage Modera speaks highly of you. What brings you to Dalaran?
92459-progress.title: Friend of the Kirin Tor

92489-accept.name: Lyonesse
92489-accept.text:
The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.

We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489-accept.title: Power Overwhelming

92489-complete.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
92489-complete.text:
A creature of pure mana? Whatever is causing this disturbance is more powerful than initial reports suggested.

Your aid bought them precious time and reminded the Kirin Tor who their allies are. Good work, $N.
92489-complete.title: Power Overwhelming

92706-accept.name: Unknown
92706-accept.text:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe
92706-accept.title: WANTED: Bruuz

94-accept.name: Theocritus
94-accept.text:
My rival, Morganth, is a vicious mage of great power who lives in the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.  I have developed a means of spying on him, the Eye of Azora, and can now view him from afar.

But to study his thoughts ... I require further aid.

If you are willing, then take my Glyph of Azora to the Tower of Ilgalar.  Place it upon the Lion Statue near the Tower.

When this is done, the power of Azora will grant visions of Morganth's future plans.
94-accept.title: A Watchful Eye

94218-accept.name: Unknown
94218-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Elixir of Defense, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94218-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Defense

94218-complete.name: Rizzle Brassbolts
94218-complete.text:
Oh, oh!! The elixir!

My, oh my. I am so sorry to have lashed out at you like that. I've been on edge ever since I was told that one of those goblins has supposedly put out a hit on me!

Sadly I cannot afford additional security, so the best I can do is chug one of these and hope for the best. Cheers!
94218-complete.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Defense

94218-progress.name: Rizzle Brassbolts
94218-progress.text: If YOU are the assassin that the crewmen keep warning me about, well you had better think twice before charging at ME, buster!
94218-progress.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Defense

94373-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-accept.text:
Aye, the time's come, young $c. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the $c's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373-accept.title: Call of Earth

94373-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-complete.text:
Well done, lad. Ye've proven yerself ready. Earth's the bedrock of all things. It'll shield ye, but only if ye show it proper respect. Even stone can shift if slighted. Learn its ways, and ye'll grow wiser than most. Never forget the secrets it shares. 

I'll craft ye a sapta now--accept it, and ye'll walk the true path.
94373-complete.title: Call of Earth

94373-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-progress.text:
Patience, lad, is the earth's finest virtue. It's seen mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys--slow and stubborn, like a true $r. The earth calls to ye now, for trouble brews on the horizon. Return successful, and ye'll be one step closer to bein' whole.

Others may envy yer wisdom, but that's their burden to bear.
94373-progress.title: Call of Earth

94374-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94374-accept.text:
Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few $c know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.

Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.
94374-accept.title: Call of Earth

94374-complete.name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
94374-complete.text:
Ah... $N... the earth welcomes you, even in this frozen land. Bound in body and spirit, you'll walk forward knowing the mountains are your strength, the plains your patience, and the world your essence.

To pass this rite, stand humbly before the earth. The other elements are not so still--they clash and roar. Learn their dual nature, even here among the snow and stone.
94374-complete.title: Call of Earth

94375-accept.name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
94375-accept.text:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, $N. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.
94375-accept.title: Call of Earth

94375-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94375-complete.text: Well done! Know this--totems ain't just a mark of yer place among shamans. They're tools, a focus for spells tied to stone, soil, and other elements. As ye grow wiser, more o' the mountain's power will open to ye. The trainers will know when yer ready for more. But for now, take this totem, and let the ground speak through ye.
94375-complete.title: Call of Earth

94375-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94375-progress.text: Ahh, ye've returned. If ye have the stone, it means the mountain's chosen ye true. I'll give ye the totem it promised. But if ye've come empty-handed, off with ye! The path ain't for those who forget their way.
94375-progress.title: Call of Earth

94472-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94472-complete.text: Take this and remember, it is sacred.
94472-complete.title: Earth Sapta

95212-complete.name: Rudra Amberstill
95212-complete.text: These pelts will make excellent saddles. You've done the Alliance proud, $c!
95212-complete.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95212-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
95212-progress.text: You look chilly, $c. How goes the hunt?
95212-progress.title: Never Saddle on Quality

959-accept.name: Brom
959-accept.text:
Oops!

Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.

Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.

Maybe you're brave enough to find him?
959-accept.title: Trouble at the Docks

96016-accept.name: Veyric Thunderhame
96016-accept.text:
Ye did good, and I can see yer itchin' fer yer reward. Sorry tae say, I'm not exactly a $r of many possessions.

<Veyric gestures broadly at his remote location.>

Tell ye what, though. I hear a troll named the Windwatcher lives out in the Alterac Mountains. He's a powerful $c himself, and an expert in storm elementals. If ye bring that there elemental core to him, I bet he can make ye a weapon worthy of yer victory.
96016-accept.title: The Tempest's Weapons

96016-complete.name: Bath'rah the Windwatcher
96016-complete.text:
Ah, this be a powerful artifact, friend! I haven't crafted with some'ting like this in a long time.

You take good care o' dis now, ya hear? Looks like ya went through plenty to get it!
96016-complete.title: The Tempest's Weapons

96016-progress.name: Bath'rah the Windwatcher
96016-progress.text:
Great battle with de elements, mm? Tings turned out how they was always meant to.

But since you here, what brings you to ol' Bath'rah?
96016-progress.title: The Tempest's Weapons

96046-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96046-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
96046-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

96046-complete.name: Yarr Hammerstone
96046-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96046-complete.title: Camping 101: Mining

96059-accept.name: Thonys Pillarstone
96059-accept.text:
Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.

It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
96059-accept.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

96059-complete.name: Thonys Pillarstone
96059-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96059-complete.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

96135-accept.name: Veyric Thunderhame
96135-accept.text:
Euck, just bein' around these blasted totems is givin' me the willies--but that's good. This much twisted corruption will be exactly what we need tae summon the quilboar's elementals.

Go to the Thousand Needles and find a suitable spot for your defenses. The steam pools should work. They're rich with fire, earth, water, and air alike. Place these totems and be ready for a fight. The Razormane won't take too kindly to yer interference.
96135-accept.title: Heed My Call

96135-complete.name: Veyric Thunderhame
96135-complete.text:
Can ye feel it, $N? The breeze sings of yer victory. If ye hadn't earned the elements' respect before, ye sure have now.

Walk tall, $c. Yer a credit to our order.
96135-complete.title: Heed My Call

96135-progress.name: Veyric Thunderhame
96135-progress.text: I can feel the storm in my belly, $N. Have ye dispersed it yet?
96135-progress.title: Heed My Call

96243-accept.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
96243-accept.text:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave $C. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
96243-accept.title: Call of Earth

96243-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
96243-complete.text: The land itself let me know ye were comin'! Aye, sometimes, the burnin' fire within us is enough to power us through the snow without even touchin' the ground!
96243-complete.title: Call of Earth

96339-complete.name: Innkeeper Wiley
96339-complete.text:
Wait, wait, you said your name was $N?

$N! I am so glad to finally meet you. Someone delivered a package here addressed to you and assured me that you would eventually come to pick it up. I tried to tell them that we don't do that around here, but before I could get a word in, they were already gone!

Your timing is great, too. It was gonna be lumped up with all the other garbage that I toss into the sea nightly.

What? We all do it. Ugh, just take your package and go!
96339-complete.title: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle

97005-accept.name: Bainham
97005-accept.text:
There are rumors of a colossal abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say it's so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.

Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.

Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me its head.
97005-accept.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97253-accept.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-accept.text:
Hey, got a sec?

So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!

I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?
97253-accept.title: Parts and Pieces

98155-accept.name: Kristy Grant
98155-accept.text:
The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels!

I would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them.

I don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.
98155-accept.title: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts

98197-complete.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-complete.text:
Ah! A bit damp, but nothing a few days in the sun won't fix.

Thank you, $c. It's nice to not solely rely on shipments from Theramore or Auberdine for once!
98197-complete.title: Spoils of War

98197-progress.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-progress.text: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!
98197-progress.title: Spoils of War

98463-accept.name: Barkeep Kelly
98463-accept.text:
Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.

The real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.

Don't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.

Nixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.
98463-accept.title: Talk of the Town

98463-complete.name: Nixxrax Fillamug
98463-complete.text:
I've got what you need, pal! Stay awhile, spend some of that gold weighing down your pocket, and have a good time.

Welcome to the Salty Sailor Tavern!
98463-complete.title: Talk of the Town
